items.description: Signed RB Jaret Patterson to the practice squad.
Designated C Cade Mays to return from injured reserve. Designated DB Brian Branch to return from the PUP list.
Designated WR Savion Williams to return from injured reserve.
Designated DB Joshua Williams to return from injured reserve.
Designated TE Will Mallory to return from injured reserve. Released TE Kenny Fletcher from the practice squad. Signed DE Carl Lawson to the practice squad.
Designated WR Dont'e Thornton to return from injured reserve.
Signed RB Carlos Washington Jr. to the practice squad. Designated DT Kenneth Grant to return from injured reserve.
Signed WRs Odell Beckham Jr. and Jeshaun Jones to the practice squad. Designated C Michael Jurgens and TE Ben Yurosek to return from injured reserve. Waived CB Tyreek Chappell.
Waived LB Jose Ramirez.
Designated LB Jaylan Ford and DB Lorenzo Styles to return from injured reserve.
Placed WR Braxton Berrios on injured reserve. Signed QB Jake Haener from the practice squad. Signed WR Dontae Fleming to the practice squad.
Designated WR Tim Patrick to return from injured reserve. Placed LB Braiden McGregor on injured reserve. Signed LB Nate Lynn from the practice squad. Signed LB Nathan Voorhis to the practice squad.

Traded G Cam Jurgens and a conditional 2027 seventh-round pick to Baltimore in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick. Signed C James Brockermeyer and WR Erik Ezukanma to the practice squad. Signed RB Dameon Pierce from the practice squad.
Signed T Jedrick Wills from the Buffalo practice squad.
Signed DB Doneiko Slaughter to the practice squad. Traded CB Joey Porter Jr. to Dallas in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick.
Signed C Daniel Burnskill to the practice squad.
Signed WR Xavier Smith to the practice squad. Placed WR Dante Pettis on the practice squad/injured list.
Designated WR Irvin Charles to return from injured reserve. Waived S AJ Finley.

Designated DB Trey Amos and RB Jeremy McNichols to return from injured reserve. Designated DE Deatrich Wise to return from the PUP list. Released DT Jeffery M'ba from the practice squad. Signed WR Nick DeGennaro, DB Darren Hall and LB T.J. Maguranyanga to the practice squad.
Waived RB Anthony Tyus III.
Reverted DB Christian Braswell to injured reserve after he cleared waivers.
Traded a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick to Philadelphia Eagles for G Cam Jurgens and a conditional 2027 seventh-round pick.

Designated WR Tank Dell, DT Kayden McDonald and OT Braden Smith to return from injured reserve. Signed DB Jaden Davis, LB Chad Muma and RB Deuce Vaught to the practice squad. Signed QB Mark Gronowski.
Signed CB A.J. Woods to the practice squad.
Signed DB Elijah Jones and WR Scotty Miller to the practice squad. Released DB Deantre Prince from the practice squad.
